CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 04 / 14

Competitive firm and output choice

Checking the global choice檢查整體最佳選擇

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Check the shutdown choice as well as candidate outputs: an MR = MC intersection alone does not establish the global profit maximum, especially with multiple intersections or discrete output.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

MR=MC 只提供候選點；還要比較其他交點、離散產量及停產。下降 MC 的交點可能是利潤最低，營運解也可能不及零產量。

MR=MC alone is only a candidate condition. Compare other intersections, feasible discrete quantities and shutdown. A falling-MC intersection can be a profit minimum, and an operating optimum can still lose more than producing zero.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：P=5; TC(0)=10,TC(1)=15,TC(2)=16. Unit 1 has MR=MC=5, but profits at q=0,1,2 are −10,−10,−6. q=2 is better.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

An MR=MC point exists but its profit is −80; shutdown loses only 50. Choose? 交點虧八十，停產虧五十？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
